findings.claim: The declared Dagger rust-build gate is no longer materialized, so `cargo build -p frf-ffi --release` can be skipped entirely.
findings.evidence: The pipeline header still declares stage 1 as `rust-build — cargo build -p frf-ffi --release`, and `dagger/README.md` lists `rust-build | cargo build -p frf-ffi --release | Must compile`, but the materialized `stages` array contains only `clippyCheck.sync()`, `swiftBindgen.sync()`, `kotlinBindgen.sync()`, `bufGen.sync()`, and `pnpmBuild.sync()`.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `rustBuild.sync()` to the `stages` array or make each dependent binding-generation stage explicitly derive from `rustBuild` so the release build is guaranteed to run.

findings.claim: The required source-bound evidence receipt for this change is missing from the diff.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 5 requires: `Save a source-bound receipt under .kbd-orchestrator/phases/production-readiness-integration/evidence/pri-c001-build-policy/; run applicable local quality checks and openspec validate pri-c001-build-policy --strict --no-interactive`, but the diff adds no file under that evidence path.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the source-bound receipt under the specified evidence directory with the required local quality-check and OpenSpec validation results.

findings.claim: The MSRV reconciliation is incomplete because the workspace manifest was not updated or shown to agree with the new CI MSRV.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion 2 requires `reconcile MSRV`, the Impact section lists `Cargo.toml` as an affected path, and constraint I4 requires `MSRV pinned in the workspace manifest`; however the diff only changes `.github/workflows/ci.yml` from Rust 1.85 to 1.94 and contains no `Cargo.toml` hunk.
findings.suggested_fix: Update the workspace manifest MSRV pin, or include a manifest hunk proving it already matches the CI MSRV.
